title: Loop replay configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input string $x$, an input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ positions, an optional state $q$, an integer $z$, and Boolean lists $w$ and $o$, form a configuration with state $q$, input-head position $p$, output string $o$, and its single work tape equal to the list-buffer encoding of $w$, with its head at position $z$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the list-buffer encoding, so its precise tape contents cannot be specified.
